text: Customer said: Order A101 arrived 4 days late, packaging was squashed. Support replied: Apologized and issued a 10% coupon for the delay.
Customer said: Order A102 dial color was black instead of silver. Support replied: Arranged exchange for silver dial watch.
Customer said: Where is the invoice for chair order A103? Need it for tax. Support replied: Emailed GST invoice PDF.
Customer said: Order A105 right ear cup audio is crackling. Support replied: Initiated 1-year warranty claim replacement.
Customer said: Can I change delivery address for charger order A106? Support replied: Address updated before dispatch.
Customer said: Is webcam order A109 compatible with macOS? Support replied: Confirmed plug-and-play compatibility with macOS.
